verdict.rationale: Sardine is an API-driven fraud and compliance platform, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only a dashboard, APIs, SDKs, sample apps and an llms.txt file, with no mention of a command-line tool. These are adjacent developer surfaces, not a CLI, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
